newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 572c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 572c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose four cents to 572 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at the opening sales in Melbourne of the second half of the 1996/97 season, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19/22 micron indicators 0.5 percent dearer and 20/24m unchanged.
The 21/25m categories were up to 1.0 percent dearer while 23m was 0.5 percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings were up to 1.0 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 26m was slightly dearer, 27m 1.0 percent dearer and 28/29/30/31m 1.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were 1.0 percent dearer, locks 3.5 percent dearer and crutchings 3.0 percent dearer.
WI said Japanese, Chinese and Taiwan interests were principal buyers in general competition.
Of the 12,719 bales offered, 2.6 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Wednesday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 33,600 bales to be offered.
